result.summary: All nine names were found in at least one source with a Montana count. Six have two or more sources: Loyola Sacred Heart High School (NCES private 2023-24 and HIFLD private copy), Hellgate High School (NCES public 2024-25 and HIFLD public copy), Rose Park (TIGER K2180 and PAD-US 'Rose Garden' at the same place), Missoula Montana Airport (FAA NASR 2026-10-01 'MISSOULA MONTANA', HIFLD aviation copy, TIGER 'Missoula International'), Community Medical Center and St Patrick Hospital (each in the HIFLD hospitals copy, FAA heliport records and TIGER K1231). Three rest on one source each: Sacajawea Park and McCormick Park (PAD-US 4.1 Fee, City of Missoula local parks) and St. Paul Lutheran church (FEMA copy of the IRS-based places-of-worship layer). Montana counts: NCES public 854 (2024-25) and private 109 (2023-24); HIFLD copies public 837, private 102, hospitals 71, aviation 320; FAA APT 318; places of worship 1074; PAD-US Fee 1457; TIGER K2180 104, K2184 101, K2188 22 (917 area landmarks in all); USGS fire and EMS 461. Licence: NCES text says public domain; PAD-US text says public domain; TIGER says free to use with acknowledgement; the HIFLD NTAD aviation copy quotes the US government work statement. Not verified: the HIFLD public school and hospital copies have no licence text; the places-of-worship points come from a commercial geocoder whose terms were not checked; the DPHHS licensure terms were not found. The evidence log is plain text (notes.txt), not notes.md, because the agent rules bar report-style .md files. Downloads total 25437209 bytes, far under the 600 MB limit; no git writes; nothing written under /home/user/wt.
blockers: maps.bts.dot.gov (the NTAD airports MapServer) returned 502 (CONNECT tunnel failed). The FAA NASR APT file was used instead.
nfdc.faa.gov returned 503 from the origin for the 2026-10-01 zip names other than APT.zip (which returned 200). Only APT.zip was used.

The HIFLD copies used (public schools, private schools, hospitals, aviation) sit under the account tqd32886_USG, not confirmed as an official HIFLD Open organisation. The HIFLD hub dataset list was not parsed, so provenance and currency are not confirmed.
